SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Officiating Games III: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Officiating Games III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Officiating Games III.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Officiating Games III.
